<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I want to help...
I want to help you grant Kaede's wish!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>I will now explain the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Closing Argument<CLT=cltSYSTEM>—
the final piece of detective work to end this trial.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>In the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Closing Argument<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, 
you will <CLT=cltSTRONG>wrap up the case<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You'll have to reproduce the order of 
events in the case in the form of a <CLT=cltSTRONG>comic book<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But this recreation is just Shuichi's deduction,
so there are <CLT=cltSTRONG>gaps<CLT=cltSYSTEM> here and there.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Gaps are areas where a number of
<CLT=cltSTRONG>pieces are missing<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>After selecting the <CLT=cltSTRONG>panels<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with <PAD=【Ｐ全】>,
press <PAD=【Ｌ３】> to move the cursor over the <CLT=cltSTRONG>gaps<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>and then fit the panel in the empty space with <PAD=【△】>.
Only the correct panel will fit!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Compare the <CLT=cltSTRONG>empty space hints<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>stock panel hints<CLT=cltSYSTEM> to complete the comic.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>There will be some panels that you
<CLT=cltSTRONG>cannot select at first<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Filling in some gaps correctly will
unlock the other panels.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press <PAD=【Ｌ１】> and <PAD=【Ｒ１】> to <CLT=cltSTRONG>switch pages<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
and start filling in as many as you can.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you, thank you!
